open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro Hnorm
  have hap : ∀ {x y u v : List Expression.Ident},
      x.Subset u → y.Subset v → (x ++ y).Subset (u ++ v) :=
    fun hx hy => List.append_subset.2
      ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ hx, List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ hy⟩
  induction Hnorm with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => exact List.nil_subset _
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact hap ih₁ ih₂
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact hap ih₁ ih₂
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact hap (hap ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | app _ _ hcond ihf ihe =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      · exact fun _ h => h
      · next H => exact absurd (hcond IsOldPred.oldPred) fun g => by cases g; exact H _ _ _ rfl
      · exact hap ihf ihe
